@name: Warrior Mage
@slug: warrior_mage
@source: essence_companion
@realms: Essence
@prime_stats: Em, Co
@description:
 Warrior Mages are Semi spell users who combine the realm of Arms with the
 realm of Essence. Their base spells primarily deal with the adaptation of
 Essence spell casting to combat and survival in hostile environments. The
 Warrior Mage is viewed by many as an elite type of fighter, specialized in
 attacking enemy spell casters on their own terms.
